newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RAM upgrades Bandar Raya bonds to A3.
newsitem.headline: RAM upgrades Bandar Raya bonds to A3.

text.p: Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd (RAM) said on Wednesday that it has upgraded Bandar Raya Developments Bhd's 145.13 million ringgit guaranteed unsecured redeemable bonds (1993/98) to A3 from BBB1.
In a statement, RAM said the A3 rating "reflects adequate safety of timely payment of interest and principal".

RAM said the upgrade is based on the projected improvement of Bandar Raya's financial strength due to divestment of its manufacturing subsidiary, Mieco Chipboard Bhd and the reduction of debt levels through internally generated funds.
It said the business risks of the group's property development operation remain to be defined by the prospects of its two main projects.
One of them, a residential development in southern Johor state called Bandar Baru Permas Jaya, "continues to receive favourable demand", RAM said.
Bandar Raya's mixed complex in Kuala Lumpur's, Capital Square, "faces some uncertainties in the sale of the condominium units and the rental of the retail centre", the statement said.
